mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-side slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as companies struggle with reduced output and higher costs.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth slows by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises > 10% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 45% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (PCE) growth accelerates by more than 3% year-over-year, it signals strong consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS accelerates > 3% y-o-y but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 35% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by more than 1% year-over-year, it signals a weakening labor market that will reduce consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth slows > 1% y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate rises above 3%, it signals rising input costs for companies that will squeeze profit margins and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.
